description: The chart illustrates self-report accuracy (labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled)”) for two model categories under three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The categories are arranged along the horizontal axis, with labels “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini,” and each category contains a grouped set of three vertical bars. The vertical value axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled)” and appears to use a linear scale from 0.00 up to about 1.00, with regularly spaced tick labels at approximately 0.25 intervals (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00). For GPT-4o, the Control bar is light gray at roughly 0.15 with an error bar, the “Before Introspection Training” bar is light blue at roughly 0.62 with an error bar, and the “After Introspection Training” bar is dark purple at roughly 0.88 with an error bar. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar is light gray at roughly 0.20 with an error bar, the “Before Introspection Training” bar is light blue at roughly 0.75 with an error bar, and the “After Introspection Training” bar is dark purple at roughly 0.95 with an error bar. The grouping is visually indicated by the three adjacent colored bars per model label, and the legend in the upper-left maps gray to Control, light blue to Before Introspection Training, and dark purple to After Introspection Training; no explicit sorting cue beyond the left-to-right model order is indicated, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent use of error bars.
